d:
The nest is empty and it's time to rediscover life as just the two of you. After years of raising a family, there's a whole new chapter waiting to be written together.
And when your husband gets down on one knee and asks, ""Will you date me?"" with a solitaire ring, there's no better way to say yes than to fall in love all over again.
Love so real, only a real diamond will do.
[ Natural Diamonds , Love From Hubby , Phir Se Thoda Romance , Real Love Solitaire , A Diamond Is Forever , Empty Nesters , Dating Again , Love After Marriage , Micro Drama , De Beers ]
